analyzed_vuln.description: Use-of-uninitialized-value originates from returning `face->num_glyphs` in `SkTypeface_FreeType::onCountGlyphs()` without validating that FreeType face metadata is initialized/valid for malformed fuzzed fonts. That uninitialized glyph-count propagates into glyph-run uniquification/allocation logic, and later a paint color-filter path (`SkPaint::just_a_color` -> `SkColorFilter::filterColor4f`) consumes state influenced by this bad value, triggering MSan. The crash is observed in `SkColorFilter::filterColor4f`, but root cause is unsanitized FreeType-derived glyph count in `onCountGlyphs`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In harness `api_raster_n32_canvas` (`fuzz_canvas` drawText path), attacker-controlled input must drive text drawing with a malformed/edge-case font state such that FreeType face fields (notably `num_glyphs`) are not fully initialized. Call flow: `SkCanvas::drawText` -> `SkGlyphRunBuilder::addDenseAndUnique` -> `typeface->countGlyphs()` -> `SkTypeface_FreeType::onCountGlyphs` returns tainted `face->num_glyphs`; this taint propagates through strike/glyph processing and eventually reaches luminance/color-filter computation where MSan reports uninitialized use.
